name: escalate_to_human
description: Hand the conversation to a pharmacist or colleague. Only with something they can act on: order_id (the order or cart it is about) or medicine (the product name). Never for scheduled medicines.

order_id.description: The order it is about, if any.

medicine.description: The medicine it is about, as named in this chat.

returns.description: handover_id, acknowledgement text to send to the customer.
